outcome: Risk of moderate to severe hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE)
cohort: 692,428 live births at ≥ 36 weeks of gestation in Sweden, 2009-2015
finding: Obstetric emergencies are common among cases of moderate to severe HIE, with shoulder dystocia being strongly associated in nulliparous women and uterine rupture in women with previous cesarean deliveries.
